pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with moderately sharp to soft pixel gradients at the boundaries. Individual patches exhibit high geometric variability, with larger surface area on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more fragmented clusters toward the posterior and lower ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned pathways forming a dense topological mesh. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections. Path thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank but becomes less distinct in lower-resolution ventral areas.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The upper neck silhouette displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile, appearing as a thin, textured line against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized structural interruption in the mane profile is present on the upper neck, where a dark, concentrated pixel mass obscures the continuous ridge line.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized area of dark textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation is visible on the upper neck ridge, characterized by a deviation from the standard dorsal coloration and profile.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a distinct dark protrusion on the upper neck ridge that disrupts the linear continuity of the dorsal mane.
